incidents.summary: Greencore admitted a December 2021 data breach in which hackers accessed employees’ personal and financial information, with affected employees subsequently seeking legal advice about compensation.

sources.title: Greencore case shows risk of employee data breach claims - Tech Monitor
sources.quote: In a letter to staff last month, Greencore admitted suffering a data breach in December, in which information including employee’s roles and salaries, bank account details and other personal information, was accessed by hackers.

sources.title: Greencore case shows risk of employee data breach claims - Tech Monitor
sources.quote: Data breach law firm Hayes Connor has taken up the case, and on Wednesday revealed it is working with up to 40 Greencore employees who suffered from the breach.

sources.title: Greencore case shows risk of employee data breach claims - Tech Monitor
sources.quote: A company statement added: “We’ve been working alongside a team of IT forensic experts who continue to investigate the incident,” adding that identity monitoring resources have been available to those affected.
